lead: Mohammed Rafi was a singer, born on 24 December 1924 in Kotla Sultan Singh.
He died on 31 July 1980 in Mumbai at the age of 55.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Padma Shri in arts.
The sections that follow break down Mohammed Rafi's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

paras: Mohammed Rafi works primarily as a musician, composer, film actor and playback singer.
He performs on reed organ and voice.
